description: Three spiral notebooks - South America, 1988; South America, Ecuador, 1988; Peru, 1988; one motel reservation receipt, Miami; one itinerary for the trip. One photocopied set of pages from a travel guidebook on Ecuador; one hotel brochure, one map of Ecuador. One page of notes on bus connections from Oaxaca, Mexico to Lima, Peru; one sheet of notes and a hotel card; two sets of photocopied pages from a travel guidebook on Lima, Peru and on Trujillo, Peru; photocopied page of the itinerary concerning Peru; a set of photocopied pages on the Incas, Cuzco, and Machu Picchu; a constellation chart.
title: Ecuador and Peru trip
